latest_release.name: v2.24.1
latest_release.body:
## Changes

* Point coding agents at the llms.txt indexes by @willeastcott in #10004

## Fixes

* Hot reload edited ESM scripts by @kpal81xd in #9989
* Clear all color attachments of a multiple render target in WebGPU viewport clears by @mvaligursky in #9998
* Read SOG v3 rotations from quats.webp by @slimbuck in #10007

### Contributors

* @kpal81xd
* @mvaligursky
* @slimbuck
* @willeastcott

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/playcanvas/engine/compare/v2.24.0...v2.24.1
